name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Interstage Inspection
intent: Interstage inspection + touch-up between coats. NO intercoat sanding — porch ceiling is a field surface.
doctrine: Interstage for porch ceiling. Inspect qt_scaled (QT3:1000, QT4:500). Touch-up qt_scaled (QT3:1500, QT4:700). NO intercoat sanding — field surface, not fine finish. Overhead rates baked in.
